name: Investi
author: investi

sections.description:
ASX, LSE/AIM, TSXV, FSE, NASDAQ & OTC investor relations — charts, announcements, email marketing & registry integration. Our comprehensive and timely data quickly summarises your current and historical share price performance, displaying charts and widgets to enhance engagement with your investor audience. Manage email campaigns, integrate with share registries, and streamline your investor communications.

Third Party Services

The charting library is Apache ECharts (Apache License 2.0), loaded from the jsDelivr CDN — jsDelivr’s privacy policy is available here.
sections.installation:
Install Investi either via the WordPress.org plugin directory or by uploading the files to your server.

After activating Investi, go to the plugin settings page by clicking on ‘Investi’ in the admin menu
sections.faq:
How do I get an API Key for a specific stock?

Please email us at contact@investi.com.au and we will provide you with one. (1 month free trial)

I’ve got to build an investor dashboard and I’ve only got 5 minutes, how do i do it?

Please see our sample Investor Dashboard page

What is the complete list of shortcodes and their arguments?

Please see our shortcodes page
sections.changelog:
1.0.33

  • new [investi-storibot] shortcode (date-format, locale, back-text attributes): lists announcements with a StoriBot page and opens it inline

1.0.32

  • Custom Domain setting: editable domain field (defaults to investors.) instead of a fixed derived value

1.0.31

  • new [investi-login] shortcode (heading attribute) for the investor login widget
  • new [investi-interactive-announcements-v2] shortcode; login-link attribute on both interactive announcement shortcodes
  • new ‘Use Custom Domain’ setting: widgets load from investors. instead of api.investi.com.au
  • investi-add-subscriber shortcode: pass through the tag attribute

1.0.30

  • investi-add-subscriber shortcode: new attributes for the Email Alerts opt-in (email-alerts-options, email-alerts-heading, email-alerts-announcements-text, email-alerts-other-text), the shareholder question (is-shareholder-option, is-shareholder-text) and submit-button-text

1.0.29

  • investi-announcements-tab shortcode: new tags attribute (e.g. tags=”regulatory,corporate”) that emits data-investi-tags so the widget filters announcements to only those carrying one of the listed tags

1.0.28

  • internal improvements to the share-price-chart widget

1.0.27
